Expected results

  • Step 1: the question "Clear {Technician-A}'s scheduled shifts?" opens, with "Keep shifts", "Clear shifts" and "Cancel".
  • Step 2: {Work-order-1} moves to {Technician-B}'s column and the message "{Work-order-1} assigned to {Technician-B}" shows, with "Undo".
  • Step 3: the message closes, {Work-order-1} goes back to {Technician-A}'s column and the message "Assignment undone" shows, with no "Undo" button. No question about scheduled shifts appears.
  • Step 4: the Schedule opens on today.
  • Step 5: {Shift-A} is there with its original end time (for example 15:00), not cut short.
  • Step 6: the Schedule shows tomorrow.
  • Step 7: {Shift-B} is back, as it was (for example 8:00 to 12:00).

Also covered by developer tests: Slavcho Mitrov (developer), 28 Oct 2026: “C682427 (shifts come back) and C682428 (invoiced in the meantime) are covered by backend and frontend unit tests, so they’d be Dev-layer.” QA lead, 28 Oct 2026: this test stays as the tester’s check of what a user sees.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); tickets SV-11522 (Tech View) and SV-11524 (Board View)

  • S4-R32: “Undo puts the work order back exactly as it was before the change: the previous lead technician (or Unassigned), its previous place in that technician’s order, and any shifts the change cleared (removed shifts come back as they were; a shift that was ended at the moment of the change gets its original end time back). Each labor line goes back to the technician it had before the change, and a line that had none goes back to none; Undo does not apply the S4-R8 line rules. Undo is itself a lead change: it records its own audit entry (S4-R9), follows the Invoiced or Paid rule (S4-N2), and shows no shift-clearing prompt. After Undo the design’s toast reads “Assignment undone”, with no Undo button on it. If Undo cannot be saved, nothing changes and the alert “Couldn’t undo the change. Move the work order back by hand.” shows.”
  • S4-R29: “The prompt reads: title “Clear {Name}'s scheduled shifts?” (with no name: “Clear the lead technician's scheduled shifts?”); text “{Name} has shifts scheduled for this whole work order. Clearing removes shifts that haven't started and ends one that's under way now. Shifts on individual lines and recorded time don't change.”; buttons “Keep shifts”, “Clear shifts” and “Cancel”.”

Last checked against build v26.43.2-539491f on 10/28/2026.
